name: bybit_cashcarry_shadow_v1_20260715
purpose: Validate mechanics and net realized paper PnL for a single-exchange Bybit long-spot plus short-linear-perpetual cash-and-carry cycle using public market observations only.
causal_sequence: observe timestamped spot and linear-perp public top-of-book
ingest only funding records whose settlement timestamp is not in the future
require at least three distinct completed positive settlements
after the third settlement, simulate spot buy at ask plus adverse slippage and perp short at bid minus adverse slippage
book later funding only when settlement timestamp is strictly after entry and a contemporaneous public perp-price proxy exists
monitor executable basis, absolute basis, delta drift, funding flip and max hold
simulate spot sell at bid minus adverse slippage and perp cover at ask plus adverse slippage
freeze one checksummed append-only four-fill cycle receipt

evidence_ladder.minimum: at least 10 completed cycles to diagnose fill, timing, persistence and recovery mechanics
at least 30 completed cycles across at least 3 liquid symbols; median and p25 net cycle PnL positive after base and stress costs; no single-symbol concentration

known_blockers_before_any_live_design: no persistent public collector/state daemon is included in v1
no exchange instrument lot-step, tick-size and minimum-notional quantization receipt
no multi-level order-book walk or partial-fill recovery state machine
no margin, liquidation, account-transfer, borrow, availability or operational reconciliation model
fee inputs are conservative constants and are not bound to an actual account fee tier
public REST calls are non-atomic; the engine refuses excessive timestamp skew but cannot make them atomic
funding settlement history does not include the exact settlement mark; v1 requires a near-time public perp midpoint proxy
no outage/restart durable open-position state because v1 cannot hold real or paper broker positions
